title: C RPL root DAO ingest: bind authenticated origin, reject foreign host routes (fail-open today)
description: lichEN C root path accepts unauthenticated DAOs and foreign /128 host routes. Evidence: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_process.c:735 lichen_rpl_dao_manager_process_dao_ex hardcodes authenticated=true; process_dao (rpl_dao_process.c:583-608) never receives the DAO source address so target==origin cannot be checked; extract_updates only enforces /128 + E=0 (rpl_dao_process.c:145-148,184). Rust reference: rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs:520-526,633-650 (has_exact_origin_target: exactly one Target, prefix_len==128, prefix==origin, rejected before staged mutation and replay-floor commit at routing.rs:573). Python reference: python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_manager.py:869-886. Fix: add verified-origin (and authenticated) parameters through lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/include/lichen/rpl_routing.h:655,671; reject target != origin; fail closed when origin is absent; rewrite lichen/tests/rpl_routing/src/main.c fixtures (install_one/process_one :150-165 advertise foreign targets, DAO source not modeled). Acceptance: foreign /128, /0, broad prefixes rejected pre-mutation; host CMake suite (lichen/tests/rpl_routing) green with new deny cases; no regression in rpl_dao_sequence/rpl_dodag suites. Part of epic project-LICHEN-2auf.44.9.2 (decomposed).
close_reason: Implemented verified-origin binding at C RPL root DAO ingest. Evidence: commit 65ca175106. (1) API: lichen_rpl_dao_manager_process_dao/_ex now take (const uint8_t *origin, bool origin_authenticated) — header lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/include/lichen/rpl_routing.h, impl rpl_dao_process.c, all callers synced (gateway rpl_root.c/h plumb-through; test fixtures rewritten). Fail closed: NULL origin or origin_authenticated=false rejects without any mutation. (2) New static dao_targets_match_origin() runs BEFORE extract_updates/staging — mirrors Rust authorize_dao_prefixes ordering (routing.rs:646-655) so rejection is byte-level zero-mutation incl. the root_state workspace scratch; /0 and sub-/128 die at the .44.7 wire profile (Target option != 18B or plen != 128), not duplicated. (3) Tests: NEW standalone host suite lichen/tests/rpl_dao_auth (runs on this Mac via cmake+ctest, mirrors rust/lichen-rpl/tests/dao_prefix_authorization.rs matrix): self-/128 accepted+applied, foreign /128 rejected with full root_state byte-compare zero-mutation + installed route preserved, unauthenticated/absent origin fail-closed, /64 and /0 wire rejects — 100% green; rpl_dao_sequence 2/2 (incl. golden sweep), rpl_dodag, rpl_srh, rpl_short_assignment all green. (4) rpl_routing ztest suite rewired (origin-aware fixtures; aggregation-deny + cross-transaction cycle preserve old coverage; new 4-row origin matrix) and compiles clean via west build -b qemu_x86_64 with Zephyr 4.1.0; native_sim RUN requires Linux — follow-up filed project-LICHEN-worker6-l327.
